title: Kenyan Masala Fries
community: The universal Nairobi café side dish
author: Mama Wanjiru

relatedDish.note: Kenyan Masala Fries is the café and restaurant version of KEN113 (Kenyan Chips Masala). Same essential recipe — this entry covers the café context, premium presentation, and the garlic mayo accompaniment that defines the restaurant version.

desc: Kenyan Masala Fries — thick-cut potato chips deep-fried until golden and crispy, immediately tossed in a fragrant spice blend of curry powder, paprika, and cumin, served with garlic mayo. The most ordered side dish in every Nairobi café and restaurant.
longDesc: Masala fries at a Nairobi café are an institution — the side that automatically accompanies every burger, sandwich, and chicken dish, and the snack that people order specifically rather than as an accompaniment. The café version is usually thicker-cut, crispier, and served with garlic mayo rather than the kachumbari of the street version.
ingredients: 800g large potatoes — cut into thick chips
steps: Make garlic mayo: combine mayo, garlic, and lemon juice. Refrigerate.
Soak cut chips in cold water for 30 minutes. Drain and dry completely.
Mix all spices and salt in a large bowl.
Fry chips in batches for 5—7 minutes until golden.
Immediately toss in spice mix while hot.
Serve with garlic mayo on the side.
chefTips: The spice goes on immediately out of the fryer — the heat is what makes it bloom.
Soak and dry chips before frying for maximum crispiness.
Garlic mayo is the café signature — non-negotiable at the restaurant level.
cookingScience: See KEN113 for the cooking science of masala chips. At café standard, a slightly higher oil temperature (175°C) produces a crispier exterior while the slightly thicker cut ensures a fluffy interior.
sustainabilityTips: Buy local Kenyan potatoes — supporting smallholder farmers.
culturalNote: Masala fries are the universal language of Nairobi café culture — the side dish that transcends age, class, and taste preference. There is no one in Nairobi who does not love masala fries.
